title: U.S. Science Is in Chaos
summary: Scientific American examines how the relationship between science and politics in America has deteriorated, with federal research funding facing uncertainty and scientific integrity being challenged by political interference. The article explores the implications of this breakdown for researchers, institutions, and the future of American innovation.
problem_solved: This article addresses the politicization and destabilization of scientific research funding and autonomy in the United States.
why_valuable: It provides critical analysis of how political decisions threaten scientific progress and why maintaining the compact between science and government is essential for national innovation and welfare.
